description: Feuerwehrhäuser des Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreises is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.en-kreis.de. This dataset shows the firehouses within the Ennepe-Ruhr district. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Firehouses of the Ennepe-Ruhr district" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Feuerwehrhaus, Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis, opendata, Feuerwehrhäuser. The listing shows 2022-10-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
